disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: The theme shows a notable divergence between real activity and price ([P2] z=2.706), yet the source-level picture is mixed rather than uniformly strong. Lobbying ramp is exceptional at z=3.5 [P3], the only robust driver; 8-K events (z=0.504) and regulatory pipeline (z=0.384) are barely above neutral, and Congress net-buy is negative (z=-1.576) [P3]. Fused acceleration of 3.817 across 4 sources [P3] is largely carried by the single lobbying source rather than broad-based activity. Price momentum is weak: 60-day relative strength vs SPY is -0.3223, z -1.851, direction negative [P4], while the radar reads POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE and forming lifecycle [P1]. No news leg [P5] means the market has not yet recognized the activity. With activity modestly ahead of price but concentrated in one source and price still falling relative to the market, this is a watch rather than an entry.
assessments.rationale_zh: 该主题在真实活动与价格之间呈现出明显的背离（[P2] z=2.706），但分来源看信号良莠不齐。游说活动急剧上升，z 值高达 3.5 [P3]，是唯一强劲的驱动因素；8-K 重大事件（z=0.504）与监管管线（z=0.384）仅略高于中性，而国会净买入为负（z=-1.576）[P3]。融合加速度虽达 3.817、覆盖 4 个来源 [P3]，却主要由单一游说来源支撑，并非全面开花的价格动量：60 日相对强弱为 -0.3223，z -1.851，方向为负 [P4]，而雷达显示 POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE、成型初期 [P1]。尚无新闻催化 [P5]，说明市场尚未认识到该活动。活动虽略领先于价格，但集中在单一来源，且价格仍相对大盘走弱，故宜观望而非入场。
assessments.rationale_plain: Behind the scenes, companies in the memory and storage space are quietly stepping up lobbying activity at a pace far above normal, but that is the only real-world signal with conviction right now—regulatory filings, major corporate events, and congressional trading are all unremarkable or even slightly negative. Meanwhile, the stocks themselves have been drifting lower relative to the broader market, and there has been no news to bring any of this activity to the investing public's attention. The setup is interesting because the behind-the-scenes push appears to be running ahead of stock prices, but it is too concentrated in one kind of activity and too early in the process to warrant a position. Watch for the quiet activity to broaden into other channels or for the stocks to stop underperforming before acting.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 在幕后，存储与内存领域的公司正以远高于正常水平的速度悄悄加大游说力度，但这是目前唯一有说服力的现实信号——监管文件、重大公司事件和国会交易都平淡无奇，甚至略偏负面。与此同时，相关股票相对于大盘一直在走弱，而且没有任何新闻把这些幕后动向带到投资者面前。这个局面之所以值得关注，是因为幕后动作似乎跑在了股价前面，但它过于集中在单一类型的活动上，且时机尚早，还不足以建立仓位。在行动之前，应观察安静的幕后活动是否会扩展到其他渠道，或者股价是否停止跑输大盘。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR toward an ENTER is [P2]'s z=2.706 divergence combined with [P1] POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE/forming: historically, early lifecycle divergences with priced-in-negative sentiment can be the highest-reward entry points precisely because no one is watching. The lobbying spike [P3] may be a leading indicator of upcoming policy or funding announcements that will trigger a news leg, rewarding those who acted before [P5] resolves. Waiting for price confirmation risks buying after the move.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 2-4 weeks, 60-day relative strength vs the market turns positive or z moves above -0.5 [P4], AND/OR a news leg materializes [P5] while lobbying remains elevated [P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Lobbying z-score [P3] reverts toward neutral without a corresponding pickup in 8-K events (z>1) or regulatory pipeline (z>1), AND 60-day relative strength remains below -0.3 with z<-1.0 [P4] for another month.

assessments.name: Memory, HBM & Storage

assessments.rationale: [P3] shows breadth is thin: only 1 of 3 sources is active (Lobbying ramp z=3.5), while Congress net-buy (z=0.039) and 8-K material events (z=-0.12) are flat. [P2] divergence z=1.463 says activity leads price, and [P1] POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE/forming supports an early, unconfirmed setup. But [P4] relative strength vs SPY is -0.0425 (z -0.08) — price is not confirming yet. [P5] no news leg. Lobbying alone does not make a durable multi-source theme; the 'fused accel 6.367' in [P3] is driven by that single source, so the composite indexes a one-dimensional signal.
assessments.rationale_zh: [P3] 显示广度很薄：3 个来源中只有 1 个活跃（游说爬升 z=3.5），国会净买入（z=0.039）和 8-K 重大事件（z=-0.12）均平淡。[P2] 差值 z=1.463 表示活动领先于价格，[P1] POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE / forming 也符合早期未确认特征。但 [P4] 相对强度为 -0.0425（z -0.08），价格尚未确认；[P5] 无新闻腿。单一游说信号不足以构成持久的多来源主题，[P3] 的融合加速度 6.367 主要由该单一来源驱动，复合分反映的是单维信号。
assessments.rationale_plain: There is one real signal here: lobbying activity around real estate has ramped up sharply, nearly four standard deviations above normal, while actual trading by lawmakers and material corporate filings are flat. That kind of one-sided activity is often an early hint that policy or deal interest is building before it shows up in prices, and the broad pattern still says activity is running ahead of price. But the market itself has not moved with it yet, and with only one source active and no news to carry the story, it is too thin and too unconfirmed to act on. The right posture is to wait and see whether the lobbying push spreads into other activity and starts to lift prices.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 目前真正活跃的信号只有一个：围绕房地产的游说活动大幅升温，强度远高于正常水平，而议员的实际交易和公司的重大申报都平平无奇。这种单一来源的活跃有时是政策或交易兴趣正在积聚的早期迹象，而且整体上活动仍领先于价格。但市场本身还没有跟进，也没有新闻来推动这个主题，单靠游说一项太单薄、太未确认，不宜贸然行动。正确的做法是继续观察，看这股游说势头是否会扩散到其他活动并开始带动价格。
assessments.dissent: Lobbying ramp z=3.5 in [P3] is a very large single-source signal and, historically, a spike of that size in an early 'forming' divergence ([P1]-[P2]) can be the leading edge of a policy catalyst that arrives before price. Waiting for multi-source confirmation risks missing the front end of the move; the flat Congress and 8-K readings may simply lag behind the lobbying build by weeks.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within the next 3–4 weeks, Congress net-buy z or 8-K material-events z turns meaningfully positive (e.g., >0.5) AND 60-day relative strength vs SPY rises above 0 with improving z, confirming activity is broadening and price is following.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Lobbying ramp z fades back below ~1.5 within 30 days while relative strength stays negative and Congress/8-K z remain flat or fall — signaling the spike was a one-off engagement and the divergence is not monetary.

assessments.name: Real Estate (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Real-activity signal is concentrated rather than broad: fused accel reads 1.847 across 7 sources [P3], but that strength is driven almost entirely by Congress net-buying (z=2.534) and news flow (z=0.674), while Federal contracts (z=0.669) and pre-award solicitations (z=0.445) are only mildly positive and 8-K material events are outright negative (z=-1.825) [P3]. Lobbying is flat (z=-0.002) [P3]. So breadth is thin — this looks like political/legislative attention plus news chatter, not yet a broad operational ramp. Durability looks better than current strength: lifecycle is emerging [P1], the divergence is positive (activity ahead of price, z=1.41) [P2], news acceleration is strong (2.067 with 100% unscheduled share) [P5], and Congressional net-buying is a slow-moving, persistent signal [P3]. Continuity is the problem: 60-day relative strength is negative (z=-0.937, dir=-1) [P4], meaning price has not confirmed the activity — the narrative is leading price by a wide margin, which could mean early opportunity or could mean the activity is not yet translating into fundamentals.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号较为集中而非广泛：7个来源的融合加速度为1.847[P3]，但这一强度几乎完全由国会净买入（z=2.534）和新闻流（z=0.674）驱动，而联邦合同（z=0.669）和预授标征求（z=0.445）仅温和为正，8-K重大事件则为负（z=-1.825）[P3]。游说活动持平（z=-0.002）[P3]。因此广度较薄——这更像是政治/立法关注加上新闻炒作，而非全面的运营加速。持久性看起来好于当前强度：生命周期处于新兴阶段[P1]，散度为正（活动领先于价格，z=1.41）[P2]，新闻加速度强劲（2.067，非计划份额100%）[P5]，国会净买入是缓慢而持久的信号[P3]。连续性是问题所在：60日相对强度为负（z=-0.937，方向=-1）[P4]，意味着价格尚未确认活动——叙事大幅领先于价格，这可能意味着早期机会，也可能意味着活动尚未转化为基本面。
assessments.rationale_plain: Space-economy activity is picking up, but in a narrow way: the main driver right now is unusually heavy buying by members of Congress alongside a burst of fresh news, while actual federal contracting and pre-award activity are only mildly positive, and company-level material filings are actually down. So this looks more like legislative attention and chatter than a broad operational build-out. That said, the signal is persistent — the Congressional buying is the kind of thing that tends to continue, and news is accelerating rather than fading. The problem is that prices have not followed: the sector has underperformed the market over the last two months even as activity has risen. That gap could mean the market simply hasn't caught up yet, but it could also mean the activity isn't translating into business results. This is worth watching closely; it is not yet a confirmed opportunity.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 太空经济相关活动正在升温，但范围较窄：目前主要驱动因素是国会议员异常大量的买入以及新闻的集中爆发，而实际的联邦合同和预授标活动仅温和增长，公司层面的重大文件披露甚至有所下降。因此这更像是立法层面的关注和舆论热度，而非全面的业务扩张。不过，这一信号具有持续性——国会买入往往是缓慢而持久的，新闻也在加速而非消退。问题在于价格尚未跟上：过去两个月该板块相对大盘表现落后，而活动却在上升。这种差距可能意味着市场尚未反应过来，但也可能意味着活动尚未转化为实际业绩。值得密切关注，但尚不是明确的投资机会。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR is that the single most powerful signal — Congressional net-buying at z=2.534 — is a leading indicator with a strong historical tendency to precede both corporate activity and price moves, and the news acceleration (2.067, 100% unscheduled) suggests information is moving fast. In this reading, the negative 60-day relative strength is precisely the entry window before price catches up, and waiting for confirmation risks missing the move.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 4–8 weeks, 60-day relative strength turns positive (z > 0) and either Federal contracts or pre-award solicitations z-scores rise above 0.8, showing operational activity following the legislative signal.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Within 4–8 weeks, Congressional net-buy z-score falls below 1.0 and 8-K material events remain negative, while 60-day relative strength stays below zero — indicating legislative attention is not translating into corporate or price follow-through.

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Activity is heavily concentrated in one source: lobbying ramp (z=3.5) and to a lesser extent gov contracts (z=1.489) [P3]. 8-K material events are negative (z=-0.433) and Congress net-buy is negative (z=-0.291), so the real-activity signal is not broad [P3]. Fused acceleration is strong at 5.682 across 4 sources, but much of that is driven by the lobbying spike [P3]. Durability appears decent because the state is POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE and lifecycle is 'forming' [P1], implying the activity may be building, though reliance on one source tempers that [P3]. Price continuity is weak: 60-day relative strength vs SPY is only 0.0139 (z 0.278), essentially flat [P4], so the market has not yet confirmed the activity. No news leg [P5] means the narrative is not yet being pushed to the public — a potential early entry — but with flat relative strength [P4] the activity is running ahead of price without confirmation.
assessments.rationale_zh: 活动集中在单一来源：游说活动激增（z=3.5），政府合同次之（z=1.489）[P3]。8-K材料事件为负（z=-0.433），国会净买入为负（z=-0.291），因此真实活动信号并不广泛[P3]。融合加速度在4个来源上达到5.682，但主要由游说飙升驱动[P3]。状态为正向背离且生命周期为形成期[P1]，表明活动可能正在积累，持久性尚可，但依赖单一来源削弱了这一点[P3]。价格连续性偏弱：60天相对强度仅为0.0139（z 0.278），基本持平[P4]，市场尚未确认该活动。无新闻推动[P5]意味着该叙事尚未向公众传播——可能是早期建仓机会——但在相对强度持平的情况下[P4]，活动领先于价格但缺乏确认。
assessments.rationale_plain: Behind the scenes, lobbying activity around consumer staples companies has spiked sharply — about three and a half standard deviations above normal — while government contract activity is also elevated. However, other real-world signals like material corporate filings and congressional buying are actually below normal, so the activity is not yet widespread. The market hasn't moved much at all: the sector is roughly flat versus the broader market over the past sixty days, and there has been no news coverage driving the story. This looks like an early building phase where insiders or interested parties are ramping up influence work before any price reaction. A cautious investor should wait for the market to begin confirming the activity — a sustained uptick in relative performance — before committing.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 消费品板块背后的游说活动急剧升温，远高于正常水平，政府合同活动也有所增加。但其他真实世界信号如公司重大申报和国会买入实际上低于正常水平，因此整体活动尚不广泛。市场价格几乎未动：该板块在过去六十天与大盘基本持平，也没有新闻推动这一变化。这看起来像是一个早期酝酿阶段，相关方在加大影响力运作，但价格尚未反应。谨慎的投资者应等待市场开始确认这一活动——即相对表现出现持续改善——再考虑建仓。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR is that the fused acceleration of 5.682 across 4 sources [P3] plus a positive divergence state [P1] may be a genuine early signal before price catches up, and waiting for price confirmation could mean missing the move. However, the single-source concentration (lobbying z=3.5, while 8-K and Congress are negative) [P3] and the flat relative strength [P4] argue that the signal could be a one-off lobbying engagement rather than a durable sector-wide theme.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 4-6 weeks, 60-day relative strength vs SPY rises above +0.05 (z > 1) AND at least one additional source (e.g., 8-K z turns positive or Congress z crosses above 0) joins the positive activity, indicating breadth expansion.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Lobbying ramp reverts toward baseline (z < 1.5) without a corresponding improvement in other sources, OR relative strength remains flat/negative for another 30 days, indicating the activity was a one-off engagement.

assessments.name: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: The narrative is real but narrow. The positive divergence [P1] and fused acceleration of 1.541 [P3] are driven almost entirely by two sources: lobbying ramp (z=2.888) and 8-K material events (z=2.518) [P3]. This points to corporate and political positioning — deal-making, contract restructurings, registration statements — rather than broad federal contracting activity. The federal contracts source is actually negative (z=-0.669), as are pre-award solicitations (z=-0.674), Congress net-buy (z=-0.307), and federal grants (z=-0.203) [P3]. Government contracts via Quiver is only barely positive (z=0.248) [P3]. Strength is therefore low-to-moderate: the signal lacks breadth across federal activity sources. Durability is moderate: 8-Ks and lobbying ramps can persist for months as a procurement cycle unfolds, and news acceleration of 2.067 on velocity 27.6 [P5] with 100% unscheduled share indicates organic, non-scheduled news flow [P5]. The activity-vs-price divergence of z=0.737 [P2] suggests activity is running ahead of price, but 60-day relative strength vs the market is negative (-0.0834, z=-0.339) [P4], meaning the market has not yet validated the narrative. Continuity is therefore poor — price is lagging badly. The theme is emerging [P1] and may be too early; the market may simply not care yet, or the activity may be strategic positioning that never converts to real contract awards. MONITOR is appropriate.
assessments.rationale_zh: 该叙事真实但较窄。正背离 [P1] 与融合加速 1.541 [P3] 几乎完全由两个来源驱动：游说活动激增（z=2.888）和 8-K 重大事件（z=2.518）[P3]。这指向企业和政治层面的布局——交易谈判、合同重组、注册声明的提交——而非广泛的联邦合同活动。联邦合同来源实际为负（z=-0.669），招标前公告同样为负（z=-0.674），国会净买入为负（z=-0.307），联邦拨款为负（z=-0.203）[P3]。Quiver 的政府合同仅略为正值（z=0.248）[P3]。因此强度处于中低水平：信号在联邦活动来源上缺乏广度。持久性中等：8-K 和游说升温可随采购周期的展开持续数月，新闻加速 2.067、流速 27.6 [P5]、非预定新闻占比 100% 表明新闻流是有机的 [P5]。活动与价格背离 z=0.737 [P2] 表明活动领先于价格，但 60 日相对市场强弱为负（-0.0834，z=-0.339）[P4]，说明市场尚未验证该叙事。因此连续性差——价格严重滞后。该主题处于新兴阶段 [P1]，可能为时过早；市场可能尚未关注，或这些活动只是永远不会转化为实际合同的战略性布局。建议观望（MONITOR）。
assessments.rationale_plain: Defense and aerospace companies are clearly positioning for something — lobbying activity is surging and companies are filing a burst of material disclosures like contract changes and restructurings. But the actual federal contracting machine is not yet turning: government contract awards, pre-award solicitations, and congressional buying are all still quiet or declining. The market has not responded at all, with defense stocks slightly trailing the broader market over the past two months. This looks like the early, behind-the-scenes phase of a defense procurement cycle — real corporate activity, but no contract follow-through and no price confirmation yet. Watch for federal contract awards and solicitations to start picking up, which would confirm the story; if they stay quiet for another month or two, the current lobbying and filing burst is likely just positioning without a deal.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 国防军工类企业显然在为某些事情布局——游说活动急剧升温，企业密集提交合同变更、重组等重大事项披露。但真正的联邦合同机器尚未启动：政府合同授予、招标前公告和国会买入仍处于低迷或下降状态。市场对此毫无反应，过去两个月国防板块表现略逊于大盘。这看起来像国防采购周期的早期幕后阶段——企业活动确实在发生，但合同落地和市场确认都还没有到来。需要关注联邦合同授予和招标公告是否开始回暖，那将印证这一判断；若再过一两个月依然沉寂，则当前的游说和披露高峰很可能只是没有落地的布局。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR is that 8-K material events and lobbying ramps of this magnitude (z=2.5+ and z=2.9) are often the earliest and most reliable leading indicators of a major defense program cycle — these are companies and lobbyists acting on non-public information about upcoming awards. The negative federal contract z-scores may simply reflect that contracts have not yet been awarded because the program is still in the pre-award negotiation phase, which is precisely when lobbying and 8-K activity peak. If so, waiting for contract awards to confirm would mean entering after the market has already priced the news — the very outcome the positive divergence [P1] and activity-ahead-of-price z=0.737 [P2] are designed to capture early. The negative price action [P4] could represent the entry window, not a red flag.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 30-60 days, federal contracts z-score turns positive (>0.5) and/or pre-award solicitations z-score rises above 0, with fused acceleration remaining above 1.0, indicating the lobbying and 8-K activity is converting into actual federal procurement.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Within 60 days, federal contracts and pre-award solicitations remain negative or flat, while lobbying ramp and 8-K z-scores decline below 1.0, indicating the positioning burst was a one-off event with no follow-through into real contract activity.

assessments.name: Defense & Aerospace

assessments.rationale: Real-activity signal is thin and one-sided. Congress net-buy is essentially flat at z=-0.092 [P3], and 8-K material events are sharply negative at z=-1.521 [P3], meaning corporate disclosures are not confirming any defensive rotation. The only bright spot is a lobbying ramp z=3.5 [P3], which is a single source and likely policy-driven rather than demand-driven. Fused acceleration reads 5.429 across 3 sources [P3], but that is dominated by the lobbying outlier. Divergence z=0.672 shows activity slightly ahead of price [P2], and radar is POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE in forming stage [P1], but 60-day relative strength vs SPY is only +0.0183 with z=0.305 [P4] — effectively flat, so price has not confirmed any defensive bid. No news leg [P5] means there is no narrative catalyst to carry the theme forward.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号薄弱且单边。国会净买入 z=-0.092，几乎持平 [P3]；8-K 重大事件 z=-1.521，显著为负，说明公司层面披露并未确认防御性轮动 [P3]。唯一亮点是游说活动激增 z=3.5 [P3]，但这是单一来源，更可能是政策驱动而非需求驱动。融合加速度达 5.429，涉及 3 个来源 [P3]，但主要由游说异常值拉动。活动与价格背离 z=0.672 显示活动略领先于价格 [P2]，雷达显示正背离且处于形成阶段 [P1]，但过去 60 日相对市场强度仅 +0.0183，z=0.305 [P4]，基本持平，价格尚未确认防御性买盘。无新闻支撑 [P5]，意味着缺乏叙事催化剂推动主题延续。
assessments.rationale_plain: Interest in defensive consumer names is uneven: the only real pick-up is a surge in lobbying activity, while actual buying by legislators is flat and corporate filings are notably quiet. Prices have not moved much either way relative to the broader market, so the big lobbying jump looks like a policy story rather than evidence that investors are rotating into safety. There is no news catalyst behind this theme right now. The sensible stance is to watch for broader activity to build before acting.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 防御性消费品板块的真实活动并不均衡：唯一明显升温的是游说活动激增，而议员实际买入基本持平，公司层面的重大披露也明显冷清。价格相对大盘几乎没有变化，因此游说数据的大幅跳升更像政策事件，而非资金真正转向防御的信号。目前这个主题背后也没有新闻催化。更合理的做法是继续观察，等待更广泛的真实活动积累起来再做决定。
